subject: Board minutes: course title and launch
body:
Board minutes — course positioning

Agreed: rename How AI Will Make You 100% Rich to AI for Your Career. Keep the launch date, Monday 9 November. This is a rename and continuation of the course.

Programs will coordinate the page and material changes. The modules need reworking within the remaining three weeks; changing the cover alone will not bring the content into line with the revised positioning.

Other business: the welcome pack needs one current setup link, and the next demo programme should describe what visitors will see. Outstanding support and facilities requests remain with their existing owners. Send corrections against the relevant agenda item, rather than circulating a competing minute.
title: Board minutes: course title and launch
